answer: Under sealed-slot burn auctions, each day's enrollment on the ridge network sells one slot through a sealed second-price auction where every bidder burns its full bid, slots halve each time bidders double, and burned funds are destroyed forever. An honest agent bidding once on the dune network burns perhaps one unit and pays the runner-up price only indirectly. The plume of destroyed capital makes flooding self-defeating, since each doubling of attacks doubles sunk losses while halving admission slots.
